title: Omnis caro ad te venie
html_source:
Omnis caro ad te veniet Latin:
“All flesh will come to thee”; after
Psalms 65: 1-2 (Vulgate 64: 1-2): “Praise waiteth
for thee, 0 God, in Sian: and unto thee shall
the vow be performed. 0 thou that hearest
prayer, unto Thee all flesh shall come.” This
passage is part of the Introit (the entrance
chant) of the requiem, or funeral, mass.

anchor.prefix: of time. Mark me now. In woman's womb word is made flesh but in the spirit of the maker all flesh that passes becomes the word that shall not pass away. This is the postcreation.
